communication_goal: 控制单次改动大小，先验证，再继续。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer stands at left beside a small desk and gestures toward a large desktop monitor at center. On the otherwise blank black screen draw exactly one large toggle switch: a horizontal pill-shaped white outline with one white circular knob visibly at its left end and black empty space to its right. Keep the toggle complete and unobstructed, with no on/off labels, numbers or symbols. The floating white OpenAI knot sits to the right outside the monitor. No other UI controls.

coverage_review.scope: V018 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅黑底白线插画，一个火柴人和一个可辨认的 OpenAI 六环结标识，无底图文字。单个胶囊形开关及圆形滑块完整，额外植物、椅子不参与教学。 准确无扩张裁剪发现初稿右/下缘过紧，已按1254原图像素位置重新归一化并保留小余量；不改变词义与对象指代。
